title: salvia abrotanoides
intro: Salvia abrotanoides, commonly known as Greek Sage, is a perennial plant native to the Mediterranean region, belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cognitive function, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Salvia abrotanoides include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective agent, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Salvia abrotanoides include phenolic compounds, such as rosmarinic acid and luteolin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
